name: Verify user identity is recognized from portal authentication
objective: Validate that the AI Assistant automatically recognizes the user's identity based on portal authentication and addresses them by name.
precondition: User is logged in and on the home page. Agentforce icon is visible.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page
Observe the greeting message from the assistant
steps.expectedResult: The assistant addresses the user by their name

steps.description: Verify the user identity is correctly recognized
steps.testData: Expected name matches the logged-in user's display name
steps.expectedResult: The user's identity is automatically recognized without requiring manual identification
